_approach: Dariacore's dubstep borrowing is structural, not just sonic: a halftime dubstep pocket (kick 1 + and-of-2, snare/clap on 3 only) dropped into a track that is otherwise running at breakcore tempo, so the halftime section feels twice as slow relative to everything around it — exactly the abrupt-tempo-feel whiplash dariacore is known for. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
